ScienceWorld (Harbor)

emrekuruu/scienceworld-harbor

Complete ScienceWorld elementary-science tasks with a command line to the simulator within 49 submitted commands.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • RL on interactive science tasks
  • seen and unseen test splits

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

A fresh simulator replays the actions and returns the best simulator score divided by 100, clipped to [0, 1].

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

uvx harbor==0.26.0 run \
  --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/emrekuruu/scienceworld-harbor@v1.0.0 \
  -d scienceworld-development@1.0.0 -i scienceworld-development-0001 -a oracle

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download emrekuruu/scienceworld-harbor --repo-type dataset --local-dir scienceworld-harbor

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/emrekuruu/scienceworld-harbor --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: Docker.

Evidence

Some simulator reference sequences do not reach 100 within the 49-command limit, so the oracle submits the usable prefix.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
